title: LP-Blind Span Segmentation Proposal Output
description: Structural, LP-blind candidate evidence spans proposed from a single lease document (Step 423B). Contains NO issue-area/provision/LP ids, NO coverage verdicts, NO risk or favorability labels, and NO legal conclusions — segmentation only. additionalProperties: false at both levels is the structural enforcement mechanism for the LP-blindness contract: adding any such field fails validation rather than being silently accepted.

quote.description: Verbatim quote of source text. Not a summary or paraphrase.

span_type.description: Structural type only — a fact about the passage's form, never a legal/semantic judgment about its role (no cap/carveout/condition/exception/remedy/cross_reference).

section_hint.description: Optional section/article label for human inspection and resolver disambiguation. Not a canonical address field — never persisted as page_ref/table_ref on the resolved EvidenceSpan.

page_hint.description: Optional page/location label for human inspection and resolver disambiguation. Not a canonical address field.

table_hint.description: Optional table row/column label for human inspection and resolver disambiguation. Not a canonical address field.

neutral_label.description: Optional short neutral description for human inspection only. NOT a routing key — no downstream code may branch on this value.
